clearNewest.sql: UPDATE sources SET last_commit = $1, last_sync_at = now(), newest_content_at = $2 WHERE id = $3

default.sql: UPDATE sources SET last_commit = $1, last_sync_at = now() WHERE id = $2

newest.sql: UPDATE sources SET last_commit = $1, last_sync_at = now(), newest_content_at = $2 WHERE id = $3

default.sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN source_id = 'default' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS default_pages, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN source_id <> 'default' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS non_default_pages, COUNT(DISTINCT source_id) FILTER (WHERE source_id <> 'default') AS non_default_sources FROM pages WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT count(*)::int AS n FROM sources WHERE NOT archived AND local_path IS NOT NULL AND local_path <> ''
SELECT COUNT(*)::int AS n FROM pages WHERE source_id = $1 AND deleted_at IS NULL

includeDeleted.sql: SELECT COUNT(*)::int AS n FROM pages WHERE source_id = $1

default.sql: SELECT id, name, local_path, last_commit, last_sync_at, config, created_at, contextual_retrieval_mode, trust_frontmatter_overrides FROM sources WHERE id = $1
INSERT INTO page_embedding_budget (page_id, state, reason) VALUES ($1, 'held', $2) ON CONFLICT (page_id) DO UPDATE SET state = 'held', reason = EXCLUDED.reason, updated_at = now()
INSERT INTO sources (id, name, local_path, config) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4)
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM persistence_source_bindings WHERE source_id=s.id AND source_incarnation=s.incarnation) AS claimed FROM sources s WHERE s.id=$1

SELECT id, name, local_path, last_sync_at, config FROM sources WHERE ($1 OR archived IS NOT TRUE) AND ($2 OR (local_path IS NOT NULL AND config->>'role' IS DISTINCT FROM 'storage_manifest')) ORDER BY (id = 'default') DESC, id
SELECT id, local_path, archived FROM sources WHERE local_path IS NOT NULL
SELECT slug FROM pages WHERE source_id = $1 AND deleted_at IS NULL AND NOT NOT (COALESCE(pages.frontmatter, '{}'::jsonb) ? 'quarantine')
SELECT local_path FROM sources WHERE local_path IS NOT NULL AND local_path <> ''
SELECT slug, source_path FROM pages WHERE source_id = $1 AND source_path IS NOT NULL AND deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT id, local_path, archived, config, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pages WHERE source_id = 'default' AND deleted_at IS NULL) AS default_has_pages FROM sources ORDER BY id
SELECT id FROM sources WHERE last_sync_at IS NOT NULL AND last_sync_at < now() - interval '7 days' AND NOT archived ORDER BY id
SELECT id, local_path, config, archived FROM sources WHERE id=$1 FOR UPDATE
UPDATE sources SET last_sync_at = now() WHERE id = $1 RETURNING id
SELECT slug, source_path, frontmatter->>'id' AS fm_id, title FROM pages WHERE source_id = $1 AND deleted_at IS NULL AND (frontmatter->>'id' = ANY($2::text[]) OR title = ANY($3::text[]))

SELECT p.slug, (CASE WHEN p.body_storage = 'segmented' THEN p.body_bytes ELSE octet_length(p.compiled_truth) + octet_length(COALESCE(p.timeline, '')) END)::bigint AS bytes, p.body_storage = 'segmented' AS segmented, p.frontmatter, b.state, b.reason FROM pages p LEFT JOIN page_embedding_budget b ON b.page_id = p.id WHERE p.source_id = $1 AND p.deleted_at IS NULL AND (COALESCE(p.frontmatter, '{}'::jsonb) ? 'embed_skip' OR (CASE WHEN p.body_storage = 'segmented' THEN p.body_bytes ELSE octet_length(p.compiled_truth) + octet_length(COALESCE(p.timeline, '')) END) > $2 OR p.body_storage = 'segmented' OR b.page_id IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY p.slug

slugs.sql: SELECT p.slug, (CASE WHEN p.body_storage = 'segmented' THEN p.body_bytes ELSE octet_length(p.compiled_truth) + octet_length(COALESCE(p.timeline, '')) END)::bigint AS bytes, p.body_storage = 'segmented' AS segmented, p.frontmatter, b.state, b.reason FROM pages p LEFT JOIN page_embedding_budget b ON b.page_id = p.id WHERE p.source_id = $1 AND p.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.slug = ANY($2::text[]) AND (COALESCE(p.frontmatter, '{}'::jsonb) ? 'embed_skip' OR (CASE WHEN p.body_storage = 'segmented' THEN p.body_bytes ELSE octet_length(p.compiled_truth) + octet_length(COALESCE(p.timeline, '')) END) > $3 OR p.body_storage = 'segmented' OR b.page_id IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY p.slug

default.sql: SELECT commit_sha, path FROM reason_purge_tombstones WHERE source_id = $1 ORDER BY commit_sha, path

pair.sql: SELECT commit_sha, path FROM reason_purge_tombstones WHERE source_id = $1 AND commit_sha = $2 AND path = $3

default.sql: SELECT slug, source_path, title FROM pages WHERE source_id = $1 AND deleted_at IS NULL AND (source_path = ANY($2::text[]) OR slug = ANY($3::text[]))
SELECT chunker_version FROM sources WHERE id = $1
SELECT id, local_path, config, archived FROM sources WHERE id=$1
UPDATE sources SET chunker_version = $1 WHERE id = $2

UPDATE sources SET config = ( WITH RECURSIVE root_layers(value, depth) AS ( SELECT COALESCE(config, '{}'::jsonb), 0 UNION ALL SELECT gbrain_try_jsonb(value #>> '{}'), depth + 1 FROM root_layers WHERE depth < 10 AND jsonb_typeof(value) = 'string' AND gbrain_try_jsonb(value #>> '{}') IS NOT NULL ), root(value) AS ( SELECT value FROM root_layers ORDER BY depth DESC LIMIT 1 ), fragment_seeds(ordinality, value) AS ( SELECT 0::bigint, value FROM root WHERE jsonb_typeof(value) = 'object' UNION ALL SELECT item.ordinality, item.value FROM root, LATERAL jsonb_array_elements( CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(root.value) = 'array' THEN root.value ELSE '[]'::jsonb END ) WITH ORDINALITY AS item(value, ordinality) ), fragment_layers(ordinality, value, depth) AS ( SELECT ordinality, value, 0 FROM fragment_seeds UNION ALL SELECT ordinality, gbrain_try_jsonb(value #>> '{}'), depth + 1 FROM fragment_layers WHERE depth < 10 AND jsonb_typeof(value) = 'string' AND gbrain_try_jsonb(value #>> '{}') IS NOT NULL ), fragments AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (ordinality) ordinality, value FROM fragment_layers ORDER BY ordinality, depth DESC ) SELECT COALESCE( jsonb_object_agg(entry.key, entry.value ORDER BY fragments.ordinality), '{}'::jsonb ) FROM fragments CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each( CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(fragments.value) = 'object' THEN fragments.value ELSE '{}'::jsonb END ) AS entry(key, value) ) || $1 WHERE id = $2
INSERT INTO reason_purge_tombstones(source_id, commit_sha, path) SELECT $1, t.c, t.p FROM unnest($2::text[], $3::text[]) AS t(c, p) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING RETURNING 1
